name: @piano/addon
description: 钢琴附加包（游戏内显示与播放）

scripts.sync:assets: npm run build -w @piano/core && npm run build -w @piano/vfx && node ../../tools/assets/sync-vfx-assets.mjs --host-only && bun ../../tools/assets/sync-stage-props.mjs --host-only
scripts.build:template: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --skip-copy --pack --mode template
scripts.build:server: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --config bepack.server.config.ts --skip-copy --pack
scripts.verify:build: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --skip-copy && node ../../tools/verify/verify-addon-build.mjs client && bepack build --config bepack.server.config.ts --skip-copy --pack && node ../../tools/verify/verify-addon-build.mjs server
